name: ICONIC
recent: Iconic Worldwide Berhad 近期因凭单转换为普通股而多次发行新股，最新一次于2026年11月18日上市。公司将于2026年11月26日召开第57届年度股东大会。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较去年同期大幅增长。
notable: 凭单转换为普通股，分别于2026年11月5日、12日及18日上市共8,790,000股新股。
将于2026年11月26日召开第57届年度股东大会。
2026财年第四季度营收环比增长184.9%，同比增长242.2%；净利同比增长65,858.8%。
risks: 凭单持续转换导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM42.257百万，环比增长184.9%，同比增长242.2%；净利为RM11.213百万，净利率26.5%，较去年同期的净利率-6.8%转正。

recent_en: Iconic Worldwide Berhad has issued new shares multiple times recently due to warrant conversions, with the latest listing on 18 Nov 2026. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, both revenue and net profit increased significantly year-on-year.
notable_en: Conversion of warrants to ordinary shares, with a total of 8,790,000 new shares listed on 5, 12 and 18 Nov 2026.
57th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 26 Nov 2026.
4QFY2026 revenue grew 184.9% QoQ and 242.2% YoY; net profit rose 65,858.8% YoY.
risks_en: Ongoing warrant conversions are gradually enlarging the share base.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM42.257 million, up 184.9% QoQ and 242.2% YoY; net profit was RM11.213 million with a net margin of 26.5%, turning positive from a net margin of -6.8% a year earlier.
